title: Deliciu V2 Raspberry Key Lime 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid by Vaporesso
description: Deliciu V2 Raspberry Key Lime Nic Salt delivers an invigorating blend of fruity raspberries and tart key lime for a complex and refreshing vaping experience. The sweet and slightly sharp notes of raspberry are balanced by the zesty citrus of key lime, resulting in a vibrant and punchy flavour combination. This expertly crafted blend is ideal for vapers who enjoy bold, fruit-inspired e-liquids with a satisfying twist of citrus. Formulated with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Deliciu V2 Nic Salts are ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape kits and pod devices. The enhanced formulation ensures smoothness and rich flavour with every puff. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, these nicotine salts provide rapid nicotine relief and a smoother throat hit compared to traditional freebase e-liquids. The Deliciu V2 range from Vaporesso revamps the original line up of bestselling flavours with a heightened focus on quality and flavour precision, delivering improved profiles based on customer feedback. Designed for compatibility with a wide range of low-powered MTL devices, Deliciu V2 Nic Salts deliver exceptionally authentic flavours and consistent, enjoyable vaping.
